title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: the seed membership probe is bounded by the organization's members, and an id-shaped person is judged by membership
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D4Jsmd91BqTVB7dSii9uJMV)_

Fixes #33280
Clause-②: no (narrowing) — narrowed: on a load for one organization, a person reference (`sys_user` lookup) whose value is UUID- or ObjectId-shaped resolves only when it names a member of that organization, where it was written verbatim. A member's id still resolves to itself; a load with no organization, a dry run and every other reference target keep an id-shaped value verbatim. Unchanged: the name/email lookup resolves the same member it did.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — the seed docs (`content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx`) and `skills/**` already teach a natural key, not an id, for a reference; the membership rule they inherit from the prior seed-scoping change is unchanged in wording.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:种子加载器按组织解析人员引用时,先读该组织的 `sys_member`(按 `user_id` 键集分页),再对每页成员做一次 `sys_user` 读取(限定成员 id 与引用值);不再按 offset 翻遍全部署同名人员。UUID/ObjectId 形状的人员引用在按组织加载时也走成员资格判定。
- 为什么改:旧探针成本随部署规模增长(托管环境每个组织都有同名样例人员),offset 翻页在并发删除下可能跳过真正的成员而误报「不是成员」;UUID 形状的值完全绕过成员规则,可以把行挂到组织外的人身上。
- 风险与回滚:收窄仅一处——按组织加载时用 UUID 指向非成员的种子引用,现在留空并报错(与按名字引用一致);成员的 id 照常解析,无组织加载不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts` 的 `probeOrganizationMember`(成员分页与「首页命中即最小 id」的论证),其次 `resolveReferenceItem` 里内部 id 短路的改动与 `judgesInternalIdByMembership`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/seed-org-scoped-references.integration.test.ts`,预期 21 个用例全绿,其中 #33280 三个新用例。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`probeOrganizationMember` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts`):

- Reads the load organization's `sys_member` rows ordered by `user_id`, a page (500) at a time, by keyset (`user_id` greater than the last one seen). No `offset` anywhere, so a concurrent delete cannot shift a page and skip the member.
- Each member page is asked ONE `sys_user` read constrained to that page's user ids AND the reference value, `orderBy id asc, limit 1`. Pages ascend by `user_id`, so the first page that answers holds the lowest-id member and the walk stops there: the "lowest id wins" rule of the previous probe holds.
- On a miss, one `limit: 1` read of `sys_user` by the value says whether anyone outside the organization answers to it; it only words the verdict ("not a member of organization ...").
- The `id` probe leg reads the one membership row directly (`organization_id` + `user_id`), then confirms the person exists.
- Cost is now bounded by the organization: an organization under 500 members answers a resolved reference with one member read and one person read, whatever the number of same-named people deployment-wide.

The internal-id skip (`resolveReferenceItem`): an id-shaped value (`looksLikeInternalId`) is still kept verbatim, except on a load pinned to an organization (not a dry run) for the target whose probe scope is `members` (`sys_user`), where it now goes through the same lookup, so its `id` leg applies the membership rule. Decision: check it. A non-UUID id (`usr_...`) already reached the membership probe through the `id` leg; the recognised shapes were the only door past the rule. A seed naming a member by id keeps working (pinned).

One changeset: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` patch, with the BREAKING note and its fix.

## Tests

New top-level describe in `packages/runtime/src/seed-org-scoped-references.integration.test.ts` (real `SqlDriver` over better-sqlite3, real `AppPlugin` replayer):

- **Bound pin**: the same replay (North resolves the member, South is refused) with 0 and with 120 same-named strangers that sort before the member; the count of `sys_user`/`sys_member` reads is equal for both, on the hit and on the miss. No read carries `offset`; every person read naming the key is constrained to member ids or `limit: 1`; every member read is walled by the load organization.
- **Id-shaped person**: a UUID of a North member resolves on North; a UUID of a South-only member is refused on North with the "not a member of organization" error, and vice versa.
- **CONTROL**: a load with no organization keeps an id-shaped person value verbatim.

The prior pins stay green: 60 same-named people with the member last, the `workspace_id`-walled object (both cases), the pass-2 back-fill that cannot see its row.

<details><summary>Ablation (each leg: on-disk mutation by scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, metadata-protocol rebuilt, marker proven in dist/, restore proven blob == HEAD, rebuilt, marker proven absent)</summary>

- Leg 1, the previous offset probe restored verbatim (page 50): `ablation-dist-preflight` "marker present in 2 built files"; integration file `Tests 1 failed | 20 passed (21)`, the bound pin red with `expected 6 to be 2` (North reads with 120 strangers vs none). Restore: `blob == HEAD (7ec7f8be7dbc) and git diff HEAD is empty`; rebuild then `--absent` green. A first attempt at this leg did not run: the mutated build failed its dts step (an unused constant), so no test ran; the replacement was respelled and the leg re-run.
- Leg 2, the internal-id skip restored (the membership judgement forced off): marker present in 2 built files; `Tests 1 failed | 20 passed (21)`, the id-shaped person case red (`expected ... to deeply equal ...`: North's non-member UUID kept). Restore proven the same way; `--absent` green.

</details>
